translations.b0106: Part 4  Deepening the Building of Digital China and Raising the Level of Digital and Intelligent Development
translations.b0107: Keeping pace with the prevailing trend of digital, networked and intelligent development, China will fully leverage its strengths in abundant data resources, a complete industrial system and extensive application scenarios, unlock the potential of data as a production factor, accelerate innovation in digital and intelligent technologies, deepen and expand AI Plus, empower economic and social development and the improvement of governance capacity, and promote profound changes in the mode of production and a revolutionary leap in productive forces.
translations.b0108: Chapter 12  Strengthening the Efficient Supply of Computing Power, Algorithms and Data
translations.b0109: China will take a coordinated approach to building computing power facilities, developing models and algorithms, and supplying high-quality data resources, thereby consolidating the foundation for digital and intelligent development.
translations.b0110: Section 1  Strengthening Support from Computing Power Facilities
translations.b0111: The layout of computing power facilities will be coordinated and their construction carried out in an orderly manner, and computing power resources will be developed on a large scale and in an intensive, green and inclusive way. The building of national hub computing power facility clusters will be accelerated; regions with suitable conditions will be supported in developing an appropriate amount of computing power to meet the needs of low-latency scenarios; and coordinated development of cloud, edge and device computing will be advanced. The supply of high-performance, high-quality intelligent computing resources will be increased, and the case for building ultra-large-scale intelligent computing clusters will be assessed. Market-based construction and operation of computing power facilities will be promoted; computing power needs will be met through multiple means such as government procurement of computing services and computing power leasing; and standardized, scalable intelligent computing cloud services will be developed through innovation. The coordinated layout of green power and computing power will be promoted. Nationwide integrated monitoring and scheduling of computing power will be strengthened to improve access to and precise matching of computing power. The development of independent, controllable and collaboratively operating hardware and software ecosystems will be accelerated. Computing power will be made more accessible and easier to use, and the computing costs of small and medium-sized enterprises will be lowered.
translations.b0112: Section 2  Promoting Iterative Innovation in Models and Algorithms
translations.b0113: Breakthroughs in the basic theories and core technologies of artificial intelligence will be accelerated; the architecture of AI models and their algorithms will be improved and optimized; and collaborative innovation in models, chips, cloud and applications will be strengthened. An organizational model for algorithm innovation that is task-oriented, flexibly authorized and cross-domain collaborative will be established, and research on more efficient methods of model training and inference will be accelerated. Technological innovation in areas such as multimodality, AI agents, embodied intelligence and swarm intelligence will be encouraged, and pathways for the development of artificial general intelligence will be explored. General-purpose large models and industry-specific models will be developed in tandem, and high-value scenarios will be used to bring model applications to the ground and drive iterative upgrades. A system for evaluating model capabilities will be established and improved.
translations.b0114: Section 3  Deepening the Development and Utilization of Data Resources
translations.b0115: A national data resource system will be established, the statistical survey system for data resources will be improved, and a single national ledger of data resources will be created. The sharing of government data, the opening-up of public data and authorized data operations will be advanced in a coordinated way; the responsibility system for developing and utilizing public data resources and the mechanisms for the compliant use of personal data will be improved; and the development and opening-up of enterprise and industry data will be promoted. The data standards system and quality management system will be improved, the building of AI corpora will be accelerated, high-quality datasets will be developed for fields such as energy, transport, manufacturing, education, health and finance, and a system for the reasonable use of AI training data will be established. R&D and application of key technologies and equipment in the data field will be strengthened, the data industry will be cultivated and expanded, and the “Data Elements ×” initiative will be carried out in depth. National data infrastructure will be built and operated, and the action plan for the development of trusted data spaces will be implemented.
translations.b0116: Chapter 13  Fully Advancing Digital and Intelligent Technology Empowerment
translations.b0117: The AI Plus initiative will be implemented across the board; AI will be more closely integrated with scientific and technological innovation, industrial development, cultural development, improving people’s wellbeing and social governance; and China will seize the commanding heights of AI industrial application and empower all sectors of the economy in all respects.
translations.b0118: Section 1  Promoting the Deep Integration of the Real Economy and the Digital Economy
translations.b0119: The core industries of the digital economy will be expanded; industries such as next-generation communications technologies, cloud computing and blockchain will be developed; the level of industries such as high-end chips, optoelectronic devices, basic software and industrial software will be raised; and digital industrial clusters with international competitiveness will be built. The building of national AI innovation hubs will be advanced, new AI-native models and forms of business will be cultivated, and national pilot-testing bases for AI applications will be established. The intelligent, digital and networked transformation of manufacturing will be promoted, the smart manufacturing program and the industrial internet innovation and development program will be implemented, and the development of networks, identification, platforms, data and security systems and their large-scale application will be advanced in an integrated way. The digital and intelligent transformation of the services sector will be promoted, and smart agriculture will be developed. A network for promoting digital and intelligent transformation will be built, and a service system for empowering small and medium-sized enterprises with digital and intelligent technologies will be improved. The building of an open-source system will be advanced, and open-source operating mechanisms will be improved.
translations.b0120: Section 2  Creating a Better Digital and Intelligent Life
translations.b0121: The role of digital and intelligent technologies and of data as a production factor in enriching people’s lives and improving their wellbeing will be brought fully into play, and integrated applications in fields such as education, healthcare, elderly care, culture and tourism, employment and consumption will be expanded. Smart home, smart travel and smart community scenarios will be enriched, smart terminal products and services will be developed, and convenient digital and intelligent service circles for the public will be created. AI will be harnessed to help transform education models, and digital and intelligent technologies will be applied in an orderly way in scenarios such as assisted diagnosis and treatment, precision medicine, health management, medical insurance services, and elderly care and assistance for persons with disabilities. The nationwide action to improve digital literacy and skills will be carried out in depth, and the job-creating effect of AI will be enhanced. Active efforts will be made to use digital and intelligent technologies to improve primary-level medical service capacity and promote equal access to education, thereby contributing to equal access to basic public services.
translations.b0122: Section 3  Raising the Digital and Intelligent Level of Government Governance
translations.b0123: The application of digital and intelligent technologies throughout the whole process will be deepened, and government services that are ubiquitous, accessible, smart, convenient, fair and inclusive will be developed. The nationwide integrated online government service platform will be improved, the “one form for all” data system and the supporting system for public applications will be strengthened, and the sharing and use of government data across departments, levels and regions will be promoted. The deployment and application of large AI models in the field of government affairs will be advanced in a safe, prudent and orderly manner, and a new service model that accurately identifies needs, proactively plans services and handles matters intelligently throughout the process will be explored. AI-enabled security governance will be deepened, and capacities for awareness and early warning, command and decision-making, precise management and immediate response will be enhanced.
translations.b0124: Chapter 14  Fostering a Healthy and Orderly Development Ecosystem
translations.b0125: China will take a coordinated approach to promoting development and exercising regulatory management, strengthen the development of basic data systems and rules and of AI governance, and foster a development environment that is beneficial, secure and fair.
translations.b0126: Section 1  Improving the Basic Systems for Data as a Production Factor
translations.b0127: Basic systems for data as a production factor will be established and improved, covering data property rights, data circulation and utilization, income distribution and security governance. The system of structurally separating data property rights will be improved, and a unified national registration system for data property rights will be built. An open, shared and secure national integrated data market will be developed, rules and standards for data circulation and trading will be improved at a faster pace, the layout of data trading institutions will be optimized, and third-party professional service institutions will be developed in a well-regulated manner. A pricing mechanism for data as a production factor will be established, and a data income distribution mechanism that balances the interests of all parties will be explored. Laws and regulations in the data field will be improved, and rules for the management of data collection, storage, circulation and use will be improved. Classified and tiered data management will be implemented, and data security protection capabilities will be enhanced.
translations.b0128: Section 2  Improving Sound and Effective Regulatory Mechanisms
translations.b0129: The safety regulatory framework for new technologies and new forms of business will be improved, mechanisms for the development and adjustment of technical standards and for the tiered management of technology applications will be established, and multi-stakeholder collaborative governance will be advanced. Laws, regulations, policies, application norms and ethical guidelines in the field of AI will be improved; systems for algorithm filing, transparency management and security assessment will be strengthened; and rules will be explored for determining the ownership of rights in AI-generated content and the rights and responsibilities of developers, operators and users. A risk management system covering the entire life cycle of AI will be developed, and a risk prevention and control system covering security monitoring, risk early warning and emergency response will be improved. Innovation and healthy development of the platform economy will be promoted; regulation of platform enterprises in terms of data, algorithms, traffic and rules will be strengthened; and win-win development of platform enterprises, businesses operating on platforms and workers will be advanced. Acts such as data abuse, deepfakes and privacy disclosure will be cracked down on in accordance with the law.
translations.b0130: Section 3  Expanding International Cooperation in the Digital and Intelligent Field
translations.b0131: A global network of digital partnerships will be built, cooperation in areas such as e-commerce, digital payments and smart cities will be deepened, and the development of offshore computing power facilities and infrastructure for cross-border data flow services will be explored. China will actively participate in international governance in areas such as AI, digital currency and cross-border data flows, build greater consensus on data security, privacy protection and cross-border law enforcement cooperation, and strengthen international judicial coordination and mutual recognition of rules. China will promote the establishment of an AI governance framework with broad participation by all countries, work with others to build an open global AI ecosystem that upholds equal rights, mutual trust, diversity and mutual benefit, and support Global South countries in strengthening their AI capacity building.
